> Movements above 5,000 are reported for review but do not stop the pipeline.

## What it checks

`amount` is at most 5000.

## When it fails

The violation is recorded in the quality report and `dq_audit`, and the batch is still published. Set `ALERT_ON_WARNINGS=true` to be notified.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_txn_high_value_review`.

## Tested by

No sample-data scenario trips this rule yet: it guards against cases the generators don't produce.
